basis: fixture-only deterministic SVG rendered to PNG; no live quote or synthetic economic series

identityColumn.line1: asset name followed by the existing 3 pt status dot
identityColumn.line2: short code | last-close or observation date
identityColumn.alignment: the combined name/meta block is centered on the 26 pt icon
identityColumn.textFit: native Text is compressed inside the 27 pt name reservation; the dot remains after the text within 40 pt
identityColumn.dateSource: row.time, reduced to a date or time token without changing the source value

quoteColumn.inlineUnit: compact unit is placed between value and variation, away from the divider
quoteColumn.alignment: the value/variation pair is centered on the icon

chartPolicy.window: real timestamped observations inside the last 24 hours

tests: explicit name/dot reservation and native HStack spacing
long names, negative values, missing dates and unavailable charts
26 pt icon with centered identity and quote blocks
enlarged pixel crops checked for IPCA, Ibovespa, Diesel S10 and the other names in both panels

rasterInspection.method: PNG raw-pixel scan plus enlarged crops; dot pixels and name pixels were measured separately after rasterization
